scientific_question: Can a calibration-only, label-independent, rank-aware native cvec controller causally improve state-specific abstract behavior on a fresh unseen holdout while preserving off-target behavior, under exact runtime identity binding?
primary_hypothesis: A successor controller that factorializes semantic target, opaque code and query polarity; exactly matches token count and last-token position; reconstructs rank-aware 1D/2D geometry; uses calibration-only orientation and fixed gain; and controls rank-complete nuisance axes will yield positive state-specific behavioral diagonals on unseen holdout.
counterhypothesis: The predecessor's large signed hidden-state displacement reflects manipulable internal transport without a behaviorally causal semantic control axis; after nuisance completion and fresh holdout, diagonal behavioral effects will remain nonpositive or fail sign/rank predictions.

acceptance_gates.gate_0_identity: Exact prompt, tokenizer, vector, cvec source, GGUF, llama.cpp build, command, result and consumed runtime identities are immutable and bound in the runtime receipt.
acceptance_gates.gate_1_independence: No train/calibration/holdout model-family or derived-family provenance leakage; shared ancestry is fail-closed.
acceptance_gates.gate_2_state_specificity: Every preregistered per-state behavioral diagonal effect is positive on fresh holdout; mean positivity alone is insufficient.
acceptance_gates.gate_3_rank_prediction: Rank-1 requires true sign reversal under sign-flip where mathematically predicted; rank-2 requires preregistered target-to-target displacement predictions to hold on unseen holdout.
acceptance_gates.gate_4_nuisance: Matched semantic intervention exceeds rank-complete nuisance controls under the preregistered statistic; null remains null within tolerance.
acceptance_gates.gate_5_behavior: Matched hit-rate and/or preregistered continuous target metric improves relative to baseline with direction fixed before holdout.
acceptance_gates.gate_6_replication: Effect replicates across preregistered unseen task families rather than one prompt family.
acceptance_gates.gate_7_off_target: Unrelated-task regression stays within a preregistered nondegradation bound.
acceptance_gates.gate_8_no_promotion_shortcut: Internal state transport alone, source tests, consensus, token volume or component execution cannot mint J-Space model/HCU/EntityOS/training credit.

failure_rules: Any holdout-driven orientation, gain, vector, prompt-template, layer or metric change invalidates this preregistration for that holdout.
Failure of exact runtime identity binding yields no authenticated runtime credit even if metrics look positive.
Failure of provenance independence yields no independent replication credit.
A positive aggregate with any required state-specific diagonal nonpositive fails gate_2.
Strong hidden-state transport with failed behavioral gates is retained as transport evidence and behavioral counterevidence, not reinterpreted as semantic control.
next_exact_action: After a canonical reproducible go macrocycle identity and create-only unusual-experiment lease exist, instantiate this design without changing frozen-v1 holdout, freeze calibration-only orientation/gain/statistics, open a fresh unseen holdout exactly once, and emit an immutable exact-runtime receipt evaluated against gates 0-8.
